hook: Claude moved Anthropic's API from Python to Rust

beats.say: Anthropic migrated its Messages API from Python to Rust after traffic grew roughly 1,800 times from early 2024 to fall 2026.
The Rust version passed about 98 percent of tests in April, yet only a quarter of inputs matched on production traffic, so agents chased down the differences.
The result uses about 70 percent less CPU per request and cuts median time to first token by about 20 percent, with no downtime.
